consumed_dependencies.used_for: Inputs structure for deposit and exit deployment receipts

verification.mutations: None dedicated: the four projection theorems are trivial field access; the interfaces themselves are structural declarations with no algorithmic content to mutate. Downstream mutants on the consumers (SourceChecks, Admission, Inputs) remain in effect.

strengthened_claims: CompleteAdmission names five hypotheses (SourceChecks, Admission, sender read, recipient equality, Nonblob) that a canonical Ethereum admission producer must supply for the represented nonblob ordinary call path.
Deployment names the two FactoryHistoryGuarantees.Inputs records and the linked-worlds equation that canonical deployment production must supply for two_seeds.

SystemAuthorization names the three ActualJournalHistory.Trace.system input fields (caller = sysAddr, value = 0, dataFit) that canonical SYSTEM authorization must supply for a single empty-data zero-value invocation.
AllHooks bundles the three above; propHooks projects the Prop-valued half.
eliminated_inputs: The previous need for consumers to enumerate each raccordement's input tuple by hand at each call site.

domain.initial: Interface declarations. No Ethereum semantic claim; no protocol policy adopted; no witness of the interfaces is claimed to exist.
domain.scope: Auditable single-site declaration of the exact input tuples the existing conditional theorems accept for admission, deployment and SYSTEM authorization.
domain.trust: Canonical Ethereum production of witnesses of these interfaces remains an external obligation. When such production becomes available, the existing conditional theorems compose without further wiring.

clause_map.original: Remaining hookups to Ethereum semantics (complete admission, deployment, SYSTEM authorization) without adopting protocol policy.
clause_map.claim: Three structure interfaces plus four small projection theorems. The interfaces name what a canonical producer must supply; the projection theorems make the interior fields available in the exact shape downstream theorems accept.
clause_map.consumer: Downstream conditional theorems already accepting these fields as separate arguments.
